schemes.name: Agricultural Development Scheme (ADS)
schemes.summary: The main annual farm support scheme - flat-rate area payments to Active Farmers.

deadlines.label: Register a new agricultural business (to receive 2026/27 booklet)

schemes.name: Agri-Environment Scheme (AES)
schemes.summary: Payments for managing farmland to benefit wildlife and habitats. Up to £2m/year, delivered with Manx Wildlife Trust. Runs alongside the ADS.

deadlines.label: Primary Initiatives Application Form sent with ADS paperwork (late April)

schemes.name: Agriculture & Fisheries Grant Scheme
schemes.summary: The umbrella capital grant scheme approved by Tynwald, covering several agricultural and fisheries grants.

schemes.name: Advisory Grant
schemes.summary: Help with the cost of professional advice for your farm business.

schemes.name: Farm Plastic Disposal Scheme
schemes.summary: Scheme for the disposal of used farm plastics.
